lines.en: Swinging his longsword forward.

lines.zh: 剑尖划过空气，发出尖啸。
lines.en: His sword slices through the air, making a shrill noise.
His eyes glow as he searches for enemies.

lines.zh: 脚步沉稳，仿佛踏破虚空。
lines.en: His footsteps are heavy, as if breaking through the void.

lines.zh: 剑刃反射着月光，寒气逼人。
lines.en: The sword reflects moonlight, giving off a chill.

lines.zh: 步伐坚定，如鬼影般无声。
lines.en: He moves with determined steps, a silent ghost.
His longsword swings, releasing a cold glow.

lines.zh: 目光紧盯着目标，步步逼近。
lines.en: His eyes fixed on the target, moving closer.

lines.zh: 步伐间透露出死亡的气息。
lines.en: His steps carry the scent of death.

lines.zh: 剑尖指向地面，寒气四溢。
lines.en: His sword points at the ground, sending out cold air.
He patrols quickly along the riverbank.
Scabbard clinking, he keeps walking.

lines.zh: 手持长刀，警惕地四下张望。
lines.en: Holding his longsword, he looks around cautiously.

lines.zh: 目光阴冷，似乎预见死亡。
lines.en: His cold eyes seem to foresee death.

lines.zh: 剑刃微动，发出细微的响声。
lines.en: His sword blade moves, making a soft sound.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，随时准备战斗。
lines.en: Standing quietly, ready to fight.
His longsword reflects a faint light.

lines.zh: 刀尖垂着，我数自己的呼吸。
lines.en: Blade lowered, I count my own breaths.

lines.zh: 手持长刀，如雕塑般静止。
lines.en: Holding his longsword, he stands still like a statue.

lines.zh: 剑尖轻触地面，寒意渐生。
lines.en: His sword lightly touches the ground, sending out coldness.

lines.zh: 警惕地环顾四周，寻找敌人。
lines.en: He looks around cautiously, searching for enemies.
His longsword is always ready in his hand.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，眼中寒光闪烁。
lines.en: He stares at the player, his eyes glowing with cold.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，剑刃微颤。
lines.en: His eyes lock on the player, his sword trembling slightly.

lines.zh: 剑尖指向玩家，寒气逼人。
lines.en: His sword points at the player, sending out a chill.

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着玩家，等待机会。
lines.en: He cautiously watches the player, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 目光如刀锋般锐利，锁定目标。
lines.en: His gaze is sharp like a blade, locking onto the target.
My knuckles whiten around the hilt.

lines.zh: 剑尖对准玩家，寒气逼人。
lines.en: His sword points at the player, giving off a chill.
His eyes are like lightning, locking onto the player.
His sword blade moves, pointing at the player.
His eyes are like those of a wolf, staring at the player.
sobbing and falling

lines.zh: 普通队士也会疼，我咬牙撑住。
lines.en: An ordinary corpsman feels pain too; I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 普通队士，也有普通队士的剑。
lines.en: Even a rank-and-file slayer has a blade.
staggering down
moaning and falling

lines.zh: 我不是柱，可我也举得起刀。
lines.en: No Hashira, but I can still raise a blade.
howling and falling
weakened fall
My uniform tears; I drop to one knee.
struggling to kneel

lines.zh: 被鬼引诱了，我要杀了它们！
lines.en: Haunted by the ghosts, I must slay them!

lines.zh: 我的剑能斩断一切恶灵！
lines.en: My sword can cut through all evil spirits!

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，否则死定了！
lines.en: Stay away from me, or you die!

lines.zh: 你们这些恶鬼，我要将你们斩为碎片！
lines.en: You miserable ghosts, I will cleave you to pieces!
The way of the Demon Slasher, fear not!
You won’t harm my territory!

lines.zh: 让它们尝尝我的水之呼吸！
lines.en: Let them taste the Water Breathing technique!
I fear no evil spirits!
Purify this tainted land!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的誓言，永不止息！
lines.en: The Oath of the Demon Slayers endures!
My sword has touched you!

lines.zh: 挡在我面前的，只能灭亡！
lines.en: Those in my way will perish!

lines.zh: 我的刀锋划过你的身体！
lines.en: My blade slices through your body!

lines.zh: 队士的剑，挡不住鬼的爪。
lines.en: A rank-and-file sword cannot stop a demon's claws.
My sword slices through the air!

lines.zh: 我的水之呼吸不算漂亮，但挡得住。
lines.en: My Water Breathing is not pretty, but it holds.

lines.zh: 我的剑刃划破了你的皮肤！
lines.en: My sword has cut your skin!
You cannot harm me!
My sword has pierced you!
You can’t stop my power!
Fight with me!

lines.zh: 我们共同消灭这些恶鬼！
lines.en: We shall together destroy these evil spirits!
Join me, be my companion!

lines.zh: 队士只剩我们两个，别散开。
lines.en: Only two of us left, don't break apart.
Fight beside me, against the evil spirits!
Join me, and destroy the evil!

lines.zh: 让我们并肩作战，击败恶鬼！
lines.en: Let’s fight together and defeat the evil ghosts!
Stand beside me, and fight the evil!

lines.zh: 与我共同战斗，消灭邪恶！
lines.en: Fight with me, and destroy the evil!
Fight beside me, and together!

lines.zh: 村田的鬼刀发出阴冷的寒光。
lines.en: Murata's ghost blade glows cold.
You touched my blade!
Absorb your soul.
My sword won't let you get close.
Murata's technique!

lines.zh: 感受到死亡的气息了吗？
lines.en: Feel the breath of death?

lines.zh: 我只是个普通队士，但也拔刀。
lines.en: I'm an ordinary slayer, but I draw my blade.

lines.zh: 你不够格成为我的对手。
lines.en: You are not worthy to be my opponent.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的存在就是为了净化。
lines.en: Ghostslayer exists to purify.
Let this blade end your life.
Game in sight.
I am just an ordinary corps member.
Time to strike.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的训练从未间断。
lines.en: Ghostslayer training never ends.
Feel my blade.
I will not let any evil ghost go.

lines.zh: 我的剑技将引领你走向终结。
lines.en: My technique will guide you to your end.
Evil spirit, die!
Ghostslayer won't fail.
My sword is justice.
He catches the scent of a demon.
His grip on the hilt goes white.
He lowers his stance and holds his breath.
Footsteps join the sound of water.
He nods toward the demon's shadow.
An ordinary slayer still draws his blade.
Sever your lifeline.
Death blade in hand.
Feel the edge of my sword.
By the name of the sword, you are sentenced to death.
My technique cannot be provoked.
Death is everywhere.
The sword is the source of death.
Sword tip points at you.
Water Breathing: Surface Slash.
His blade draws a line of water.
He counts the demon's breaths.
His footwork shifts three times.
Ripples flow along his blade.
He drives the demon back against the wall.
He keeps the blade tip low.
He waits for the demon to slip.
His breathing runs thin as a stream.
He turns and gives half a step.
The blade flashes through the spray.

lines.zh: 挥剑砍向你，发出低沉的呼啸声。
lines.en: Swinging sword, making a low howl.

lines.zh: 你的剑与我的剑碰撞，发出铮鸣。
lines.en: Clashing swords, making a jingle.

lines.zh: 我挥剑砍中你，鲜血洒落。
lines.en: Swinging sword, blood splatters.

lines.zh: 我挥剑砍向敌人，剑刃划破空气。
lines.en: Swinging sword, slicing through air.

lines.zh: 我的剑刃割破你的肌肤，剧痛。
lines.en: My blade cuts your skin, intense pain.

lines.zh: 我用剑攻击，剑尖直指你的胸膛。
lines.en: Swinging sword, pointing at your chest.

lines.zh: 我用剑刃割裂你的肉体。
lines.en: Swinging sword, tearing your flesh.

lines.zh: 挥剑砍向你的头部，鲜血如泉涌出。
lines.en: Swinging sword, blood gushing from head.

lines.zh: 挥剑砍中你的手臂，你痛苦地嘶吼。
lines.en: Swinging sword, your arm bleeding, you howl in pain.

lines.zh: 我的剑挥出，你的身体被劈成两半。
lines.en: Swinging sword, splitting your body in two.
A flat cut shears the demon's shoulder.
Water Breathing: Water Wheel.
One step forward, and the blade falls.
The edge slides down the demon's arm.
He adds a backhand cut.
His blade flicks the demon's claw aside.
He shoulders the demon off to shield those behind.
Blood spatters his uniform.

lines.zh: 从墓地中爬起，发出低沉的呻吟。
lines.en: Rising from the grave, making a low moan.

lines.zh: 我从地下爬出，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: Crawling out of the ground, seeking a target.

lines.zh: 从阴影中现身，我寻找猎物。
lines.en: Appearing from the shadows, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 在夜幕下出现，等待猎物到来。
lines.en: Appearing in the night, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 我游荡在这片墓地，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Wandering in the graveyard, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 从腐烂的地下爬出，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Crawling out of the rotten ground, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中现身，准备攻击。
lines.en: Appearing in the dark, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 我从废墟中爬出，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: Crawling out of the ruins, seeking a target.

lines.zh: 在墓地中现身，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Appearing in the graveyard, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 从破败的建筑中爬出，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Crawling out of the ruined buildings, seeking prey.
He comes around the bend of the mountain path.
Night dew still clings to his uniform.
He stops and scans the treeline.
Blade still sheathed, he is already alert.
flames bite

lines.zh: 从空中摔下来，剑差点脱手。
lines.en: Falling from the air, my sword nearly slipped.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，刀也握不住。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I cannot hold my blade.
torn by explosion
pierced by arrows
tears of magic
Too hungry to grip my blade...
struck by lightning

lines.zh: 水之呼吸在虚空里没有水。
lines.en: Water Breathing has no water in the void.
